output.reply: Hi Maria, thanks for letting us know, and sorry for the trouble with the duplicate Lumen Plus charge. We're passing this to our billing team, who will check both charges from the 3rd against your account and follow up with you about the duplicate. If you have the last four digits of the card or a screenshot of the statement, please reply with them to help speed up the review.

Thanks for letting us know, and sorry that pasting tables from Google Sheets is now collapsing the columns into a single line. We've passed this to our team along with your browser details (Lumen web on Chrome 131). In the meantime, pasting into a new table in the note, or importing the data as a CSV file, may help keep the columns intact.

Thanks for reaching out, and sorry you're locked out of your Lumen account. Since the reset link goes to your old work inbox, our team will need to verify your identity before we can update the email on your account. Please reply with the old and new email addresses and any details that help confirm the account is yours, such as your workspace name or plan, and we'll guide you through the next steps.
